main_text.p: Roy: Et Rex quidem caput honoris ergò populo detegere cernebatur; sed liberale istud Le Roy vous remercie, quod per suos identidem responderi jubebat, exaudire per immanes strepitus & clamores non licebat. Interea cadaver Marchionis in cubiculum janitoris protractum; postridie verò sine funeris apparatu elatum, in D. Germani, sub organo forte, in fossam abjicitur, ore pronum, capulo in dorsum illiso; Sed à plebeja rabie mox effosum, ad patibulum raptatur: Et ubi ex pedibus aliquantisper suspensum fuerat, comburitur: cineres in profluentem sparguntur: Hæc in irritum & ridicula sævitia, quæ larvas impetit, & dentem fatigat in exuviis; istud commiserationem jure habeat: Uxor occisi Marchionis Eleonora Dori, in carceres detrusa, exquisitis

page.notes: The right-hand printed page is only partly visible and shows faint marginal fragments (e.g. "Quæst.") that are too incomplete to transcribe reliably. Some words in the text were read with uncertainty, notably "fossam", "effosum" and "exquisitis", which runs on to the next page.
